other_text: "I have often wondered if the majority of mankind ever pause to reflect upon the actual significance of dreams, and of the obscure world to which they belong." - H.P. LOVECRAFT, "BEYOND THE WALL OF SLEEP"
moderation_notes: Contains occult themes and psychological horror elements.
